= AhaWiki =
* [https://ahawiki.net]

A wiki engine, written in Scala on Play. Several wikis run on one instance, told apart by the host they are asked for.

== Documents ==
* '''AGENTS.md''' — how to work in this repository, and an index of everything below.
* Developer documentation lives on the wiki, under [https://ahawiki.net/w/Dev Dev], mirrored in <code>docs/ahawiki.net/</code>:
** [https://ahawiki.net/w/Dev%20RunningLocally Dev RunningLocally] — what to arrange before <code>sbt run</code> gives you a working server.
** [https://ahawiki.net/w/Dev%20Testing Dev Testing] — how the tests get a database schema.
** [https://ahawiki.net/w/Dev%20Database Dev Database] — what the columns mean.
